items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining elevated access to sensitive resources without authentication. Exploitation attempts were observed shortly after disclosure.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (B2B Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Unauthenticated Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Admin Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses seven vulnerabilities, including critical and important ones, that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary Code Execution via Webhooks
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 10.0) unauthenticated, zero-interaction flaw in the webhooks component that can lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Malicious File Upload Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) that allows an attacker to plant malicious files on the server.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Feature Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity authorization flaw (CVSS 8.7) that could lead to privilege escalation or security feature bypass.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Feature Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity authorization flaw (CVSS 8.6) that could lead to privilege escalation or security feature bypass.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Feature Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity authorization flaw (CVSS 8.2) that could lead to privilege escalation or security feature bypass.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Feature Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity authorization flaw (CVSS 8.1) that could lead to privilege escalation or security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 9.3) unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes that allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.
